title: Administration of the Gifts and the Register of Priests
description: During King Hezekiah's reign, the Levite Conaniah and his brother Shimi were placed in charge of the gifts, tithes, and holy things in the temple, with ten overseers under them. The Levite Kore distributed the voluntary offerings, while other Levites assigned shares in the priestly cities. A careful register was kept of priests, Levites, and their families to ensure fair distribution.
